label: SPORTS HISTORY
voice_script: In one game, Diego Maradona scored the most infamous goal in history... and the most brilliant. First, the 'Hand of God.' Leaping against a keeper six inches taller, he punched the ball into the net. The referee didn't see it. The goal stood. Maradona's explanation? It was scored 'a little with his head... and a little with the hand of God.' Just four minutes later, he did the impossible. A 60-yard run, past five defenders, a goal of breathtaking genius. Cheat and genius, in the same man, minutes apart.

screens.text: The Most Infamous Goal In History
